questions.prompt: How do you push a file from the host into an instance?
questions.explanation: lxc file push <source> <instance>/<path> copies a file from the host into an instance.

questions.prompt: How do you create a snapshot of an instance?
questions.explanation: lxc snapshot <instance> <snapshot-name> creates a point-in-time snapshot.

questions.prompt: How do you restore an instance to a previous snapshot?
questions.explanation: lxc restore <instance> <snapshot-name> reverts the instance to the snapshot's state.

questions.prompt: How do you delete a snapshot named 'clean' from instance 'first'?
questions.explanation: Snapshots are deleted with lxc delete <instance>/<snapshot-name>.

questions.prompt: What command pulls a file from an instance to the host?
questions.explanation: lxc file pull <instance>/<path> <destination> copies a file from the instance to the host.
